Cerveaux: modele Gemini experimental deprecie corrige, fallback multi-modeles ajoute.

proposals.name: B2B Local Historical Societies & Small Castles (Châteaux)
proposals.buyer_persona: Volunteer preservationists, local museum directors, and owners of private historic estates looking for budget-friendly custom merchandise to fund operations.
product_angles: Custom coloring books featuring the exact architectural details of their specific monument
Print-on-demand vintage-style postcards and posters of their local history using public domain assets
Laser-cut-ready STL/SVG architectural ornaments of their buildings for local gift shops
proposals.first_test_product: A high-quality 24-page physical coloring book of a specific regional French castle sold directly to their association shop.

proposals.name: Solo Game Developers seeking UI/UX Asset Packs
proposals.buyer_persona: Indie game developers building cozy games, retro RPGs, or mobile puzzles who lack graphic design skills and need ready-to-import UI components.
product_angles: Cozy cottagecore theme UI kits (buttons, panels, borders) in SVG and PNG
Godot-optimized 2D UI themes ready to drag-and-drop
proposals.first_test_product: A Cozy Forest UI Starter Pack with 50+ modular SVG elements on itch.io and Unity Asset Store.

proposals.name: Solo Board Game Designers (PnP - Print & Play)
proposals.buyer_persona: Tabletop game hobbyists who print and assemble their own games at home, constantly looking for high-quality, low-cost thematic printouts.
product_angles: Minimalist Print & Play micro-games (18-card limit) with high replayability
Printable dry-erase legacy campaign tracking sheets
Custom dice tower STL models designed for low-filament FDM printing
proposals.first_test_product: A solo pocket-sized card game PDF with print-ready sheets and rulebook on Etsy and WargameVault.

proposals.name: Hydroponics, Aquaponics & Soil-less Urban Gardeners
proposals.buyer_persona: Tech-oriented apartment dwellers and urban farmers optimizing indoor vegetable growth using smart systems.
product_angles: Parametric STL models of modular modular vertical planting towers for 3D printing
Indoor garden tracking journals and nutrient calculators (KDP and digital PDF)
Minimalist vector stickers for labeling nutrient reservoirs and seed pods
proposals.first_test_product: A set of 3D-printable modular hydroponic net-pot adapters and custom spacers on Cults3D.

proposals.name: Historical European Martial Arts (HEMA) Practitioners
proposals.buyer_persona: Passionate sword-fighters, historical researchers, and combat sport athletes who find mainstream medieval gear too 'fantasy-oriented' and want historical accuracy.
product_angles: Logbooks specifically designed for tracking fencing bouts, weapon drills, and techniques (KDP)
High-contrast vector SVG graphics of authentic 15th-century fencing manuals (Liechtenauer, Fiore) for apparel
3D printable sword wall mounts and gear organizers optimized for heavy steel feders
proposals.first_test_product: The HEMA Fighter's Training Logbook: a structured 120-page notebook for bout tracking and technique sketches on KDP.
